exclusionReason: Lift interior arrows/marks, ExitConcourse caption letters, disconnected endwall strokes and lower-edge stair/fence attachments are not counted as free-standing support symbols.

sourcePhoto.observation: Rectangular lower pier visibly continues platform→Exit edge girder→Main underside. Several other photo supports are similarly lower framing, distinct from large lattice roof columns.
sourcePhoto.limit: This photographic family is not individually cross-identified to each plan symbol.
